PowerShell(npx tsc --noEmit 2>$null | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $env:TEMP\\tserr3.txt; $lines = Get-Content $env:TEMP\\tserr3.txt | Where-Object { $_ -match 'error TS' }; "Remaining: $\($lines.Count\)"; $lines | ForEach-Object { \($_ -split '\\\('\)[0] } | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Format-Table Count, Name -AutoSize)

PowerShell(npx tsc --noEmit 2>$null | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $env:TEMP\\tserr3.txt; $lines = Get-Content $env:TEMP\\tserr3.txt | Where-Object { $_ -match 'error TS' }; "Remaining: $\($lines.Count\)"; Get-Content $env:TEMP\\tserr3.txt | Where-Object { $_ -match 'org-shared|kampGenereringCup|kampService|stevne-stats' })
PowerShell(npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json 2>$null | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $env:TEMP\\tserrtest.txt; Get-Content $env:TEMP\\tserrtest.txt)

PowerShell($errs = Get-Content $env:TEMP\\tserrtest.txt | Where-Object { $_ -match '^tests/' } | ForEach-Object { if \($_ -match '^\(tests/[^\(]+\)\\\(\(\\d+\),'\) { [pscustomobject]@{File=$matches[1]; Line=[int]$matches[2]} } } | Sort-Object File, Line -Unique; $errs | Group-Object File | ForEach-Object { $f = $_.Name; $content = Get-Content $f; ""; "=== $f ==="; $_.Group.Line | Sort-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { "{0}: {1}" -f $_, $content[$_-1] } })
PowerShell(npx fallow dupes --format json --quiet -o fallow-dupes.json; $r = Get-Content fallow-dupes.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $r.PSObject.Properties.Name; "TOTAL: $\($r.total_issues\)")

PowerShell($r = Get-Content fallow-dupes.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; "GROUPS: $\($r.clone_groups.Count\)"; $r.clone_groups | ForEach-Object { $g = $_; "---- group \($\($g.instances.Count\) instances, $\($g.lines\) lines, $\($g.tokens\) tokens\)"; $g.instances | ForEach-Object { "  $\($_.path\):$\($_.start_line\)-$\($_.end_line\)" } })

PowerShell($r = Get-Content fallow-dupes.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $i = 0; $r.clone_groups | ForEach-Object { $g = $_; "[$i] $\($g.line_count\)L $\($g.token_count\)T:"; $g.instances | ForEach-Object { "    $\($_.file\):$\($_.start_line\)-$\($_.end_line\)" }; $i++ })

PowerShell($r = Get-Content fallow-dupes.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $i = 0; $r.clone_groups | Where-Object { $_.instances[0].file -notmatch 'database.types|^tests/' } | ForEach-Object { $g = $_; Write-Output "===== [$i] $\($g.line_count\)L $\($g.token_count\)T"; $g.instances | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "  @ $\($_.file\):$\($_.start_line\)" }; Write-Output $g.instances[0].fragment; $i++ } | Out-File -Encoding utf8 fallow-fragments.txt; \(Get-Content fallow-fragments.txt | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines)
